subject: URGENT: Your account will be suspended
body: Dear user, your account will be suspended within 24 hours unless you verify your credentials immediately at http://example.com/verify. Act now.
label: phishing

subject: Your invoice #4821 is past due
body: Dear customer, invoice #4821 remains unpaid. Please settle the outstanding balance immediately to avoid service interruption. This is your last chance.
label: phishing

subject: IT Security Alert: Unauthorized access detected
body: We detected unauthorized access attempts on your account. An official notice has been filed. Verify your identity now or your access will be revoked.
label: phishing

subject: Team lunch this Friday
body: Hi team, please let me know by Thursday if you can join the team lunch this Friday at noon. Thanks!
label: legitimate

subject: Monthly payroll confirmation
body: Your monthly payroll has been processed successfully. No action is required.
label: legitimate
